tailoring.headline: Senior Technical Consultant – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in techno-functional consulting, requirement analysis, user story creation and AI-assisted development. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and production support, driving robust, scalable commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Technical Consultant ServiceNow
cover_en.hook: I am excited by adesso SE’s focus on AI-driven engineering excellence and its strong SAP Commerce Cloud practice. With more than five years designing and delivering SAP Commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and consulting expertise to a senior technical consultant role.

bullets.label: **Techno-functional consulting**
bullets.text: Led requirement workshops and translated business needs into SAP Commerce specifications, ensuring alignment with stakeholder goals and seamless integration across PIM, ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: **API & Integration expertise**
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST services and built end-to-end data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) that synchronized product data across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: **Java & Spring mastery**
bullets.text: Developed high-performance backend components using Java, Spring Framework and Spring Boot, applying design patterns and performance tuning to meet enterprise scalability standards.

bullets.label: **AI-assisted delivery**
bullets.text: Utilized generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, code generation, testing and documentation, reducing development cycles while maintaining quality.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Technical Consultant ServiceNow
cover_de.hook: Die Kombination aus AI-Kompetenz und technischer Exzellenz bei adesso SE begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Beratung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen für die Position des Senior Technical Consultant mit.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: Leitete Anforderungsworkshops, übersetzte Geschäftsbedarfe in SAP-Commerce-Spezifikationen und stellte die nahtlose Integration von PIM, ERP und MDM sicher.

bullets.label: **API- und Integrationskompetenz**
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte OCC-REST-Services sowie End-to-End-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) zur Synchronisation globaler Produktdaten.

bullets.label: **Java- und Spring-Expertise**
bullets.text: Entwickelte leistungsstarke Backend-Komponenten mit Java, Spring Framework und Spring Boot und optimierte sie nach bewährten Design-Patterns.

bullets.label: **AI-unterstützte Umsetzung**
bullets.text: Setzte generative KI-Tools ein, um Analyse, Code-Generierung, Tests und Dokumentation zu beschleunigen und gleichzeitig hohe Qualität zu gewährleisten.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 (frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026) und freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: adesso SE stands out for its commitment to AI-driven engineering excellence and its strong portfolio around SAP Commerce Cloud. The company’s culture of continuous innovation, international collaboration and focus on delivering high-impact digital commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my experience and passion for techno-functional consulting. I am eager to contribute to and grow within a forward-thinking team that shapes the future of e-commerce.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join adesso SE to apply my SAP Commerce expertise in a AI-focused, innovative environment where I can drive high-impact e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Senior Technical Consultant ServiceNow role at adesso SE and would love to discuss how my background fits your needs.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Technical Consultant ServiceNow – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Technical Consultant ServiceNow position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to your team.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application further.
